question: Why do powers immersed in Shiva not become cosmic eggs?
premises: An objection arises that powers immersed in Shiva might become eggs.
Another clarifying statement is given for this case.
Those powers have not fallen from their state as power.
inference: Therefore powers immersed in Shiva do not become eggs because they do not fall from power-ness.
uncertainties: The exact referent of vākyamaparaṃ is the phrase in the next verse.
plain_english: One might object that powers immersed in Shiva would also become eggs, but they do not, because they have not fallen from their nature as power.
